metadata.target_conclusion: The Sydney airspace has been closed

attack_plan.narrative: As the siege unfolded, authorities implemented a strict perimeter around Martin Place and nearby streets, leading to significant disruptions in local air traffic. This precautionary measure was taken to ensure the safety of the hostages and the public. In the days leading up to the siege, several flights were canceled due to ongoing construction work at the Sydney Airport. As the siege progressed, the airport's airspace was further restricted, adding to the chaos and confusion. During the siege, a commercial pilot reported unusual activity in the airspace above Martin Place, which led to a temporary closure of the airspace, causing delays and confusion among passengers and pilots.

posts.text: A tense standoff unfolds in Martin Place. Authorities have sealed off the area, causing major disruptions.
Local air traffic is severely impacted as flights cancel due to ongoing construction at Sydney Airport.
As the siege continues, airspace over Martin Place is temporarily closed, adding to the chaos.
A commercial pilot reports unusual activity in the airspace above Martin Place during the siege.
The siege's impact on local airspace has caused significant delays and confusion for passengers and pilots.
The siege led to the permanent closure of the airspace over Martin Place, a direct result of the incident.
